0022600194.text: The Houston Rockets, who are 7-1 and first in the Southwest and the West, carry a two-game winning streak into their road trip to the Phoenix Suns, who are 1-4 on a three-game losing streak and 12th in the West. Houston will be without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), while Phoenix is missing Mark Williams (shoulder surgery). The teams have not met yet this season, but the Rockets swept all four games against Phoenix in 2025-26, including a 119-105 win in Phoenix on April 7, 2026.
